description: Service class for user management operations including retrieval, update, and deletion of user data.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service component responsible for user management operations such as retrieval, updating, and deletion of user data.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves all users with pagination, returning a page of UserDTO objects.

methods.name: getUserById
methods.description: Retrieves a UserDTO for a user identified by the given ID.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the UserDTO of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user details for a user identified by ID with data from UserDTO.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by ID from the repository.
